caption: The drawing depicts a square patchwork composition made up of irregular shapes in various colors and patterns, resembling a quilt or textile sampler. The patches include fabrics in shades of red, pink, blue, yellow, green, gray, black, cream, and purple, as well as printed or textured patterns such as stripes, damask, and lace. The patches are bordered and connected with decorative stitches in contrasting thread colors, including zigzag, cross-stitch, and feather stitch styles in blue, red, green, yellow, and black. Embroidered motifs are present, including two purple and white flowers with green stems on a black background, a large tan and brown butterfly in the lower left section, a white lace-like circular pattern near the center, and white leafy branches and ferns on the purple and pink patches. The drawing is centered on a cream-colored background, and there is a signature "Edith Towns" in the bottom right corner of the page outside the patchwork area.
title: Patchwork Quilt (Section)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
